summary: Agent assists customer with personal loan application status.

intents.keywords: I applied for a personal loan last month but nobody tell...

issues.issue: Lack of communication regarding application status.
issues.reason(s): Customer was not informed about the application status or the reason for the delay.

issues.issue: Application is under review due to pending CIBIL score.

intents.actions of agent: Checked the application status and informed the customer about the CIBIL score review.
intents.Process Request: Agent promised to keep the customer updated on the application status.
intents.resolution: The agent informed the customer that the application is under review due to the CIBIL score and it should reflect in 5 to 7 business days.
